eras.name: Before the Flame
eras.summary: The Vale before the Hearthflame: a cold, hard country of hill clans, river folk and dwarven holds in the Greywall. Almost nothing of it is remembered, which is itself a clue.

events.title: The Long Winters
events.summary: Generations of failing harvests and hungry winters. The hill clans and the river folk fought over what little grew. Dwarven records from this time survive only in fragments.

events.title: The Crossing
events.summary: A company of seven crossed the Greywall into the lands beyond and came back with fire. The Vale's songs say they were given it.

eras.name: The Hearth Age
eras.summary: Three centuries of warmth. The Wardens tended the Hearthflame in Ember Keep, the harvests never failed, and the Vale grew rich, settled and forgetful.

events.title: The Lighting of the Hearthflame
events.summary: The seven founders lit the Hearthflame in the hall that became Ember Keep, and swore the first Warden oath. The Hearth Reckoning begins.

events.title: Ember Keep Raised
events.summary: Dwarven masons built Ember Keep around the flame, and the Frostpeak roads to bring stone down from the heights.

events.title: The Church of the Hearth Founded
events.summary: The Church of the Hearth was founded to teach that the flame was a gift of the gods to a deserving people. Its oldest scriptures contradict its newest ones; nobody reads the oldest.

events.title: Ember Shards Sold
events.summary: The Wardens began selling small shards of the flame to lords and guilds to pay for the Keep. Ember-lamps and ember-forges spread across the Vale. So, quietly, did the forgetting.

events.title: The Cost Hidden
events.summary: The Warden-Keeper of the day learned what ember-fire takes and ordered it kept secret: the Vale could not live without the flame, so it must not know the price.

events.title: Oswin Hale Becomes Warden-Keeper
events.summary: Oswin Hale, a scholar who refused ever to touch ember-fire, became the last Warden-Keeper. He began reading the oldest records and did not like what he found.

eras.name: The Fall
eras.summary: The single night that ended the Hearth Age.

events.title: The Night the Keep Fell
events.summary: Ember Keep fell in a single night. The Hearthflame shattered and five embers fell across the Vale like stars. Every survivor's account of that night is different and every one has gaps.

events.title: What Really Happened
events.summary: Oswin Hale tried to put the flame out. He had learned it was stolen and that it was feeding on the Vale's memory, and he chose to end it. Someone stopped him halfway, and the flame shattered instead of dying. Oswin has never learned who. The Hooded Stranger was there.

eras.name: The Fading
eras.summary: The century since the Fall. The embers warmed the Vale for a time, but each year they burn lower and the cold creeps in.

events.title: The Ford Burns
events.summary: One ember fell into the river at the ford, which boiled and burned for a year. The ground stayed warm, and Emberwick grew up around it.

events.title: The Sunscar Made
events.summary: One ember struck the dry uplands and burned the best farmland in the Vale into desert in a season.

events.title: The Pass Freezes
events.summary: The ember in Frostpeak Pass went out. The mountain froze around it, the goliath holds were lost, and the dead of the pass began to walk.

events.title: The Kindled Rise
events.summary: A preacher named Maren Sorrel began teaching that the flame could be relit if the Vale was brave enough to feed it. The Kindled grew in the hungry years.

events.title: The Hungry Years
events.summary: Ten bad harvests in a row. The hill clans came down from the heights, the river towns locked their granaries, and the Ash Market's prices for ember shards tripled.

events.title: Goblins at the Ford
events.summary: Goblins of the Skarrow clan seize the bridge at the Ashen Ford, Emberwick's only road east. If they hold it past the new moon, the town goes hungry this winter. The campaign begins.
